latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release introducing detailed coverage of LINE Corporation, Japan and Taiwan’s leading super-app with 200M+ MAU.
- Includes comprehensive history, business structure, core advantages, and key performance data.
- Explains LINE’s evolution from chat app to digital lifestyle platform under Z Holdings.
- Highlights integration with Yahoo Japan and PayPay, dominance in messaging and fintech sectors.
- Covers unique cultural, IP, and market aspects relevant to Asian super-app models.
